items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Not Faiso. ... [INTERVIEWER] I see. It wasn't Faiso. [INTERVIEWEE] No, I don't remember anything.

ctx.x: Yeah, Happy Goldstein. Oh, I see. I see. And I call this what you spell on the roof garden, Manuel Perez. He used to play in the Brass Band sometimes, and he'd play a drum all day.
When Humphrey was playing trombone with the band, well Humphrey was playing trombone with the band.
